name: Bloodspray Curse
text:
You inflict a curse upon the target that causes any wound to gush blood. The target must attempt a Fortitude save.

---
Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success For 1 minute, the first time each round that the target would take at least 10 piercing or slashing damage from a single Strike, the strike deals an additional floor(@item.rank/2)d6 piercing or floor(@item.rank/2)d6 slashing damage of the same type.

Failure As success, but the Strike also deals an additional floor(@item.rank/2)d6 bleed damage.

---
Heightened (+2) The additional damage increases by 1d6, and the persistent bleed damage increases by 1d6.
